title: Synthetic credential returned in an error response
root_cause: The external error serializer includes unredacted request parameters in the response body.
attack_path: An unauthenticated client submits a request to the reachable adapter endpoint.
The adapter adds its synthetic provider key to an outbound query parameter.
A controlled provider error causes the request object to be serialized into the client response.
preconditions: The adapter endpoint is reachable by the client.
The selected endpoint uses the affected custom-error path.
impact: A client can obtain the configured provider credential and consume the privileges assigned to that key.

evidence.observation: The serializer includes the complete request parameter object.
A disposable test observed the synthetic key in the HTTP response.

counterevidence: The logging path redacts the same synthetic key.
A private network deployment can prevent an external client from reaching the endpoint.
remediation: Return a generic client error and keep recursively redacted diagnostics in operator logs.
limitations: The example uses only synthetic data and does not establish public deployment prevalence.
